gaps: No physical artifact image was visually inspected. Chosen examples are explicitly modern vector redrawings.

The Commons descriptions establish identity, provenance and stated reuse, but the web tool could not fetch SVG bytes from the exact direct links (unsupported SVG content type or cache miss). The filenames and paths came from inspected Original file links, not guessed shards.

Shuowen’s pictographic account is consistent with the early-form descriptions, but this pass does not establish detailed stroke-by-stroke graphic changes or a corruption hypothesis. No supported competing analysis was located.
Dictionary citations document examples of mouth, population, speech and openings in named texts; the earliest occurrence of each extended sense and semantic links among them remain undetermined.
No local Unihan row or official Unicode reading page was inspected in this research task; no Mandarin pronunciation claim is made.
